estimates.assumptions: 85g dry brown rice noodles as stated; typical dry rice noodle values used
1 tsp rapeseed oil (≈4.5g); pure oil has no carbohydrates
250g raw fillet steak (beef tenderloin); meat has negligible carbs
2 medium carrots (≈120g total), raw and shredded; standard carrot size assumed
½ medium Chinese cabbage (Napa cabbage, ≈300g); raw edible leaves only
4 spring onions (≈60g total), finely sliced; raw values
Small handful fresh coriander (≈10g); modest quantity for scattering
1 medium red chilli (≈20g), sliced; raw, seeds included
Juice of 1 lime (≈30g juice); standard lime size
2 tsp brown sugar (≈10g); fully dissolved in dressing
1 tsp rice vinegar (≈5g); standard mild vinegar
½ tbsp fish sauce (≈9g); typical Asian fish sauce
